0:
source_directories:
    - /minecraft
repositories:
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_DEFAULT_DOMAIN}//opt/local/minecraft
    label: onsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_OFFSITE_DOMAIN}//opt/backup/minecraft
    label: offsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
ssh_command: ssh -i /home/user/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no
archive_name_format: minecraft-{now}

mkdir -p /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot /data/plugins/PrometheusExporter

cat > /data/plugins/PrometheusExporter/config.yml <<'EOF'
host: 0.0.0.0
port: 9100
enable_metrics:
  entities_total: true
  villagers_total: true
  loaded_chunks_total: true
  jvm_memory: true
  players_online_total: true
  players_total: true
  whitelisted_players: false
  tps: true
  world_size: true
  jvm_threads: true
  jvm_gc: true
  tick_duration_median: true
  tick_duration_average: true
  tick_duration_min: false
  tick_duration_max: true
  player_online: false
  player_statistic: false
EOF

if [ -f /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml ]; then
  sed -i '/^bedrock:/,/^java:/ s/^  port: .*/  port: 25565/' /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml
  sed -i '/^bedrock:/,/^java:/ s/^  clone-remote-port: .*/  clone-remote-port: true/' /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml
else
  cat > /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml <<'EOF'
bedrock:
  address: 0.0.0.0
  port: 25565
  clone-remote-port: true
java:
  auth-type: online
EOF
fi

download() {
  url="$1"
  dest="$2"
  tmp="$dest.tmp"
  curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$tmp"
  mv "$tmp" "$dest"
}
download "$AONEBLOCK_URL" /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/AOneBlock.jar

aoneblock_config=/data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/AOneBlock/config.yml
mkdir -p /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/AOneBlock
if [ ! -f "$aoneblock_config" ]; then
  unzip -p /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/AOneBlock.jar config.yml > "$aoneblock_config"
fi
sed -i '/^  create-island-on-first-login:/,/^  [^ ]/ s/^    enable: .*/    enable: true/' "$aoneblock_config"
sed -i '/^  create-island-on-first-login:/,/^  [^ ]/ s/^    delay: .*/    delay: 0/' "$aoneblock_config"
sed -i '/^  create-island-on-first-login:/,/^  [^ ]/ s/^    abort-on-logout: .*/    abort-on-logout: false/' "$aoneblock_config"

mkdir -p /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot /data/plugins/PrometheusExporter

cat > /data/plugins/PrometheusExporter/config.yml <<'EOF'
host: 0.0.0.0
port: 9100
enable_metrics:
  entities_total: true
  villagers_total: true
  loaded_chunks_total: true
  jvm_memory: true
  players_online_total: true
  players_total: true
  whitelisted_players: false
  tps: true
  world_size: true
  jvm_threads: true
  jvm_gc: true
  tick_duration_median: true
  tick_duration_average: true
  tick_duration_min: false
  tick_duration_max: true
  player_online: false
  player_statistic: false
EOF

if [ -f /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml ]; then
  sed -i '/^bedrock:/,/^java:/ s/^  port: .*/  port: 25565/' /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml
  sed -i '/^bedrock:/,/^java:/ s/^  clone-remote-port: .*/  clone-remote-port: true/' /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml
else
  cat > /data/plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml <<'EOF'
bedrock:
  address: 0.0.0.0
  port: 25565
  clone-remote-port: true
java:
  auth-type: online
EOF
fi

download() {
  url="$1"
  dest="$2"
  tmp="$dest.tmp"
  curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$tmp"
  mv "$tmp" "$dest"
}
download "$BSKYBLOCK_URL" /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/BSkyBlock.jar
download "$LEVEL_URL" /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/Level.jar
download "$CHALLENGES_URL" /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/Challenges.jar

bskyblock_config=/data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/BSkyBlock/config.yml
mkdir -p /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/BSkyBlock/blueprints
if [ ! -f "$bskyblock_config" ]; then
  unzip -p /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/BSkyBlock.jar config.yml > "$bskyblock_config"
fi
cat > /data/plugins/BentoBox/addons/BSkyBlock/blueprints/default.json <<'EOF'
{
  "uniqueId": "default",
  "icon": "FURNACE",
  "displayName": "&cDouble Island",
  "description": [
    "&bTwo islands in one!",
    "&bCan you reach the",
    "&bdesert?"
  ],
  "requirePermission": false,
  "blueprints": {
    "NORMAL": "double",
    "NETHER": "nether-island",
    "THE_END": "end-island"
  },
  "slot": 0
}
EOF
sed -i '/^  create-island-on-first-login:/,/^  [^ ]/ s/^    enable: .*/    enable: true/' "$bskyblock_config"
sed -i '/^  create-island-on-first-login:/,/^  [^ ]/ s/^    delay: .*/    delay: 0/' "$bskyblock_config"
sed -i '/^  create-island-on-first-login:/,/^  [^ ]/ s/^    abort-on-logout: .*/    abort-on-logout: false/' "$bskyblock_config"

#!/bin/sh
echo "Borg repo create"
/usr/bin/borgmatic repo-create --encryption repokey --append-only
echo "Borg backup create"
/usr/bin/borgmatic create
echo "Borg show info"
/usr/bin/borgmatic info --last 1
echo "Borg list archives"
/usr/bin/borgmatic list
